board: Keyes / Joy-IT KY-021 mini reed magnet module (black 3-pin sensor-kit board with glass reed switch, also sold as HW-497; header S, + (middle), -)
reason: Modelled as an active-low digital sensor (normally-open reed switch from S to GND with on-board 10k pull-up to +, S LOW when a magnet closes the reed); debounced driver; check passed on ESP32 and Pico in the first run.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://arduinomodules.info/ky-021-mini-magnetic-reed-switch-module/ (S, middle +V, -), confirmed by Joy-IT product image https://sensorkit.joy-it.net/files/files/sensors/KY-021/KY-021.png
